name: Lac des Mille Lacs
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from a 1974 MNRF transect survey (year from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 30.4 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (70.7% of water cells at >=0.4). Cool-regime lake; walleye (BsM: 102 sets) and cisco in the ARA community. Secchi 1.8 m (ARA).
